summary.text: Brandolynn Yarbrough is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 71 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Justin Howard (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described more than 22 years of professional experience spanning business, affordable housing and healthcare accessibility.

paragraphs.text: Brandolynn Yarbrough earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of West Georgia, according to her Ballotpedia survey.

The survey describes her career as including work to expand access to affordable housing and improve healthcare accessibility for people in underserved communities, and community advocacy in Carroll County and surrounding areas.
Yarbrough listed affordability, workforce opportunities and healthcare access as the three key messages of her campaign.
